subject.title: fix(stream): recover visible content when reasoning_delta straddles an inline code span (closes #96869)

question: May OpenClaw reclassify a provider's `reasoning_content` as user-visible solely because adjacent visible Markdown has an unclosed code delimiter?
rationale: The report demonstrates real message loss, but the proposed provider-agnostic inference trades that loss for possible disclosure of private reasoning; source inspection cannot decide which boundary maintainers intend to prioritize.

options.title: Require explicit provider capability
options.body: Preserve reasoning-field privacy by default and enable recovery only for provider/model contracts with evidence that visible continuations are emitted in that field.

options.title: Accept generic Markdown recovery
options.body: Merge the heuristic with an explicit decision that preventing truncation outweighs possible private-reasoning disclosure for mixed chunks.

options.title: Pause the recovery path
options.body: Leave current classification unchanged until a reliable signal can distinguish mislabeled visible continuation from genuine private reasoning.

recommendation.title: Require explicit provider capability
recommendation.body: Preserve reasoning-field privacy by default and enable recovery only for provider/model contracts with evidence that visible continuations are emitted in that field.
